svg.text: Noctiluca · a live log beside a stream

g.text: drop spacers, tracking pixels and icons marked decorative
keep small pictures (emotes, badges, icons) in their line
cap picture heights; what is under them moves up
an Image: line under a picture with alt text and no caption
show buttons, icon-only ones too, as [ label ] from their name
snap grids to the width, columns from the cells there are
collapse navigation and sidebars to a row on narrow terminals
draw a picture of text as its text (changes meaning: off)
live logs show their newest entries unless scrolled up
keep saturated text colours, readable; greys follow the terminal
lower frame rate and tier when the terminal is short of bandwidth
a toggles adapted and faithful · in the config or --adapt=-RULE switch one off · Esc closes
f1 actions · f hints · o open · r reader · q quit
